Hi Samantha — sorry for the trouble. I pulled the invite you attached and saw the calendar body has a Meet URL wrapped in a long redirect token; looks like the forwarding process rewrote the token and caused the host validation to fail.

Immediate options: 
- I can send a short join link (redwood.live/<shortcode>) that bypasses the tokenized redirect and stays valid for 48 hours.
- Or we can re-issue a new calendar invitation from our side with a canonical host key; that'll preserve RSVPs but takes a few minutes to regenerate.

Ben / Priyom — can one of you create the shortlink and add an ephemeral backup Zoom link as a secondary join method? If we do both, we should include the shortlink in the calendar description and paste the Zoom link into the Slack channel so internal staff have a fallback.

I'll wait 10–15 min for the shortlink before re-issuing the invite to avoid duplicate events.

Best,
